_comment: Dev build config - dev-api.docwellness.fit + dev-environment SDK keys. Pass with `flutter run --dart-define-from-file=config/dev.json` (or use scripts/run-dev.ps1 / the VS Code 'dietician (dev-api)' launch config). Every value here is safe to commit: Sentry DSNs and PostHog project API keys are designed to be public/client-embeddable, and the Supabase publishable key only permits what RLS allows. Real secrets (JWT signing keys, DB passwords, Supabase service-role key) never belong in a Flutter dart-define.
